tests.name: ui_button_multi_tick_interaction
tests.description: Multi-tick UI button interaction test that chains mouse over collision detection with action processing. Tests full subscriber activation workflow across 2 ticks: (1) Mouse release at (150,125) generates USER_INPUT event which activates subscriber and processes button action, adding response EVENT_TEST to waiting room; (2) Final validation shows EVENT_TEST moved to EventBus. Validates CUserInterface component state transitions and event flow through EventBus and waiting room.
